addons.name: Quick-Sell
addons.teaser: Turbo-charge your sales! A charming little SMTM add-on that shuffles inventory into buyers’ hands at worrying speed.
addons.description:
A quick update regarding SPT 4.1: As some of you might have noticed, the Forge will be shutting down soon. You can find the Discord message explaining the reasons here: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/875706629260197908/1533159965597110352

Due to this announcement, I have decided to put the SPT 4.1 update for this mod on hold for now. I apologize for the disappointment. My time for modding is quite limited as it is, and considering the uncertain future of the project right now, I think it makes the most sense to step back.

What does it do?

In the grand tradition of making life marginally easier (and infinitely more entertaining), this mod allows you to instantly sell items from your inventory to traders or the flea market using a configurable keyboard shortcut combined with whichever mouse button you feel most emotionally connected to.

By default, the universe is arranged thus:

  • Q + Left-click → Sell to trader (the financially sensible option)
  • Q + Right-click → Sell on flea market (the entrepreneurial-but-risky option)
  • Q + Middle-click → Sell at the best price, as determined by arcane calculation and a faint whiff of magic

All relevant configuration settings from the venerable Show Me The Money mod are automatically applied, as if by an invisible accountant lurking in the background.

If you’re using UIFixes v5.0.2 or later (Tyfon’s delightful gift to humanity), you can even select multiple items and sell them all at once. When selling on the flea market, items of the same type are automatically bundled. Like socks in a dryer, except these actually stay together.

Requirements

  • You must possess the mighty Show Me The Money SPT-mod, version 2.2.0 or newer, without which this quick-sell addon would spend its days staring listlessly into the void.

SPT 4.x Installation

Extract the contents of the .zip or .7z file into your SPT directory with all the elegance and grace of a caffeinated space hamster.

After that, you should find exactly this file in your SPT installation:

- C:\yourSPTfolder\BepInEx\plugins\com.swiftxp.spt.showmethemoney.quicksell\SwiftXP.SPT.ShowMeTheMoney.QuickSell.Client.dll

SPT 3.11.x Installation

Extract the contents of the .zip or .7z file into your SPT directory with all the elegance and grace of a caffeinated space hamster.

After that, you should find exactly this file in your SPT installation:

- C:\yourSPTfolder\BepInEx\plugins\SwiftXP.SPT.ShowMeTheMoney.QuickSell.dll
If you use the Fika headless client

Splendidly simple advice: do not install this mod there. Nothing good will come from doing so. The client will ignore it, you’ll think it’s broken, and the universe will sigh. If you’re using Corter’s Mod Sync, please add this mod to your Exclusions.json.

Configuration

Adjust all settings through the BepInEx configurator (summonable through F12 or F1, assuming the stars are aligned and your keyboard cooperates):

Remarks

  • Quick-selling is currently possible only from the inventory screen, likely because attempting to do it mid-raid would tear a hole in the fabric of space-time (and also be wildly unbalanced).

Known compatibility

  • UIFixes v5.0.2 or later for SPT 4.0.x by Tyfon
Support and feature requests

All support and requests for new features will be handled as time permits, often between cups of tea and existential reflection. Please be patient. The universe is large, confusing, and full of bugs.

addons.name: anOrangeDoggo's SAIN Presets
addons.teaser: A collection of personal presets aimed for fun gunfights for varying levels of players
addons.description:
anOrangeDoggo’s SAIN Presets

Just want to share the repo of my presets along with the commit history in the off chance it might help people make their own. I might make a wiki or something, idk. SoonTM. Maybe never.

If you have questions, try look through the commit history. Or, search through the Discord conversations. Many topics related to the core gameplay aspects are mostly already answered.

I also want to give a shout-out to Solarint, the maker of SAIN, and all the maintainers and contributors for the amazing mod, and the SPT devs for years of SPT support.

How Are These Compared to XYZ

My presets are all Default SAIN through and through, so you should be expecting standard SAIN experience in the bot behavior department.

The only things I made significant changes to are related to aiming, shooting, and hearing stuff. And a bit on the vision speed and some other stuff I probably forget. Again, it’s all in the commit history.

Many areas are standardized to Default, with mostly aiming and shooting varied for Hard and Challenging. Challenging is more difficult than Hard (I nO EnGlIsH SpOkE) as it offers substantially tighter shot grouping and faster aim time. Hard is essentially Default with basic knobs turned a bit more.

Overall, I don’t really know. I haven’t played any other presets for weeks if not months now on top of jumping in and out of other games. All I can say is that they all should be easier than Twitch Players in the sense that they don’t give bots eagle eyes and extreme reaction time, and harder than SAIN’s Default because bots shoot more accurately. That leaves only one way to find out.

Or, check out my gameplay of Challenging 0.2.1 (YMMV, obviously):

Note that bots walking around with their guns down aren’t part of my presets or SAIN. It’s an in-development mod by the creator of HollywoodFX and HollywoodCam. I highly recommend these mods.

Here’s a gameplay with just SAIN, Acid’s bot mods, and other QoL, item, etc mods of my choice. I think this setup should be pretty close to what average SPT enjoyers have.

Before You Install

DO NOT report any bug or strange behaviour to SAIN’s maintainers during the use of my presets.

DO NOT view my presets in the in-game GUI. Simply select one without expanding/droping down anything. Some of the values are outside of the acceptable ranges and, upon revealing through the GUI, will be clamped to what are actually allowed. Although, unless you hit Save or Export All, it should not be affecting the presets. SAIN will work just fine even if some of the values are a bit odd.

Nothing less of another mod will save you from head-eyes if that’s your kryptonite. I personally increase the head’s health to 85 via Server Value Modifier, so I can survive small to intermediate, high pen rounds. But anything bigger than that I’m cooked.

If you find any issues, like bots not moving, are blind and/or deaf, etc, chances are you already have that before you even download the presets. Make sure everything is up-to-date and your standard SAIN is already working normally. Ombarella is known to make bots go blind if not being configured correctly. I personally don’t use it.

Installation

If you download directly from the Forge, you should get the latest version of each preset all bundled in one zip and properly structured. You can extract the zip directly into your SPT folder.

If you’re on the GitHub page, on the right side, under Releases, click Tags. Then download any version 0.2.0 or newer of the source code of your choosing preset. Then extract anOrangeDoggo - <difficulty> to your SAIN’s preset folder.

The path should look like this: <SPT>\BepInEx\plugins\SAIN\Presets\<Preset Folder>. For example, SPT 4.0\BepInEx\plugins\SAIN\Presets\anOrangeDoggo - Hard.

Since I have many presets available at once, each will have its own versioning to track the development, which is also independent of the others. The versioning of the bundle on the Forge will be incremented only when I decide to include any new version of a preset and thus does not represent the actual versioning.

See Also

Twitch Players

Live Like Experience

Try To Act Human

and other presets since SPT 3.8-3.9 (don’t use them in 3.11 or 4.0, though).

I learned a lot from these presets by going through their repo. Be sure to check them out, too!

Recommended Mods

I have my mod list on the GitHub page and I recommend them all. However, some of them directly impact my experience with bots. For example:

Acid’s Progressive Bot System affects bots’ gears and thus how each Personality will be assigned. Better gears means higher chance of Chad and GigaChad, for example.

Acid’s Bot Placement System controls how bots spawn. The default settings should work just fine.

NerfBotGrenades since SAIN’s grenade settings aren’t working yet.

Recoil Rework BSG’s recoil is boring. I use 1.0 for vertical recoil.

Dynamic Maps easily ESP your way to gunfights! Also invaluable for preset tuning.

Fontaine’s FOV Fix I do enjoy zoom-in feature of Arma and Insurgency. This makes iron sights usable at longer ranges. By default, it does not do any zoom when you ADS.

Agony SFX bullet wounds aren’t ant bites.

Audio Accessibility Indicators if you’re playing at night, or have trouble hearing things in Tarkov in general.

Increase Climb Height in case you want to out-maneuver the bots.

addons.name: AMQWR Patches Addon
addons.teaser: Manually tuned configs for custom traders and quests so you can do pew-pew with suitable modded weapon
addons.description:
General

AMQWR version 2.20 or higher is a HARD requirement, this mod is just bunch of configs for AMQWR. If version is lower - things won’t work in proper way!

You have dozens of new guns for your SPT setup? New hundreds of quests? And still you have to use the very same vanilla guns for quest progression? Here we are, presenting precise configs to match your new shiny guns with quests!

Main goal of that mod is to precisely match weapons from mods with quests having “Eliminate with xxx” conditions without adding extra weapons that are not matching. And ONLY that type of condition. Any other quest conditions like “find”, “stash” and etc currently are not supported by AMQWR logic.

Currently 100% covered next quest mods:

  • Vanilla EFT quests
  • Lotus quests 1.7.2
  • Ref - SPT Friendly Quests 2.0.3
  • WTT-Armory 2.0.5
  • AES 0.7.9
  • Scorpion 1.0.0
  • Legs 2.1.2

Next weapons and weapon packs included:

  • Massivesoft weapons
  • C11 - True North
  • Epic’s All in One
  • Eco’s Attachment Emporium
  • Echoes of Tarkov - Requisitions
  • SOCOM armory
    • some overrides for vanilla weapons (like adding to another weapon group)

Weapon mods are not hard requirement: if you don’t have some of them - things will still work!

Installation
  1. Install AMQWR if you don’t have it
  2. Unpack addon archive with patches into SPT root directory, confirm overwrite.
Support

IF YOU DON’T HAVE ANY OF QUEST MODS FROM THE LIST - YOU WILL RECEIVE “Mod: (XXX) is missing”. IT’S TOTALLY FINE, YOU HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH IT

Some quests are added into processing blacklist. It’s not a bug, it’s by quest design and/or AMQWR logic and/or available weapon mods.

Also wanna notice that >95% of quest have very precise patching, but some things are… opted in I guess, as, for example, AEK-973 really isn’t an AK platform gun (well, it is, but it’s deeply modified) so there are some weapon groups a bit wider than it should be, though I’ve did it with intention to cover as much weapons as possible without totally ruining “spirit” of quest.

For assistance about issues (like not counting gun XXX into progression of quest YYY) please do next:

  • first of all carefully read conditions, in some cases kills won’t count towards progression because of wrong weapon modules. Ultra reminder: modded silencers, scopes and tactical devices/flashlights are also added into conditions, but only in cases where it sounds like “do x kills with silenced weapon” or “use EOtech scopes”, if u see exact attachment names - use things that are in list.
  • In some quests you need to do kills with xxx or yyy guns and then stash it somewhere. You are able to do kills with extended (modded) guns suiting the condition, but still have to stash vanilla ones. Sad, but true.

addons.name: Baconism's Unrepentant Bots (SAIN Preset)
addons.teaser: This preset will cause some mild head/eyes.
addons.description:
DISCLAIMER: THIS PRESET IS MEANT TO BE USED IN CONJUCTION WITH ORBIT

(due to SAIN extracting being disabled, thus letting ORBIT handle bot extraction.)

I made this preset with the goal of making my personal experience on SPT as intense but also infuriating as possible. And what I mean by that is… killing a squad of PMCs who will laser you if you aren’t quick and accurate will feel satisfying. But if you mess up, you WILL die, A LOT. If you’re a borderline masochist like me, and like basically torturing yourself on Tarkov but without the problems that Live Tarkov brings, this preset is for you. But if you aren’t looking for that kind of thing, that’s okay, this preset just isn’t for you.

In order to get the intended experience, I’d suggest making sure all PMC bots are set to Impossible difficulty.

Installation

  1. Make sure you have SAIN installed
  2. Download the add-on and drag the “BepInEx” folder into your SPT installation folder (same one as the Launcher and Server).
Some of the changes made to make the AI a lot more difficult are (but not limited to, since I forget all the things that were tweaked):
  • Much faster reactions
    • CQB reactions are on for all bot types that SAIN controls, minimum reaction speeds are reduced but not impossible to deal with, if you repeek an angle, expect to get shot before you even see the bot, best to reposition and never repeek the same angle twice.
  • Higher overall accuracy, MUCH less random scatter, CoM is closer to head.
    • Bots will be very accurate very quickly after starting to shoot globally, Precision Speed Multiplier is increased to 1.25. Accuracy Speed set to 0.75, which makes their shots more accurate over time, just quicker to do so. Scatter Multiplier is set to 0.35, this setting is what has the most effect in them being very deadly. Center of Mass is set to 0.225, which is around the upper chest, which reduces the chance of getting a blacked stomach, but will also increase the chance of getting headshot due to random scatter and recoil.
There is also some other changes made to make the AI more balanced but not insanely difficult to where it’s not fun with their increased accuracy and overall deadliness:
  • Hearing randomization increased, and ranges reduced in these categories:
    • Increased the randomization at which sound location pinpointing operates, thus reducing their accuracy in finding exactly where a sound came from.
    • Surgery Usage, I reduced this to around 35 meters from the default of (I think) 70 meters, makes it less likely to get rushed by a nearby bot when doing surgery after a fight.
    • Healing, Reduced to 35 meters as well.
    • Aiming Down Sights, reduced to 25 meters from 35 meters, not a huge difference, but could make the difference when being stealthy.

I have long felt that the AI hearing is wayyyy to good and will basically lock onto you through walls, effectively giving them ESP. And from my personal experience, these changes help to alleviate that somewhat. Keep in mind bots still can be pinpoint accurate in locating exactly where you are with the more sound you make. So results may vary.

I probably missed a bunch of other changes made to the preset, but I’ve been tweaking this for like 5 months and didn’t ever think to document my changes. Anyways, I hope you enjoy this SAIN Preset, I wasn’t originally going to make the preset public but I had gotten some requests to do so, and I thought “Why not? Maybe some people would enjoy it like me.”

Cover image was generated by ChatGPT as something quick to slap onto the add-on.

addons.name: Matts Better Boolets and Booms
addons.teaser: This is a simple add-on that adds new boolets and grenades, but keeps them balanced so there is no break in progression or difficulty. This now has restricted Arena Ammo. Another major feature of this Add-on has become a total rebalance of shotgun shells.
addons.description:
Per Shaneeexd this addon is compatible with version 2.3.0 AND 2.4.0 of Ammogen. Both work without issue.

General Purpose

This mod is aimed at filling in gaps in ammo and helping some weapons feel a bit better to use. This is not a hyper ammo or depleted uranium mod. Those are fun, nothing is wrong with them. But that’s not what I want, and maybe there are some that agree. Basically, I wanted to make less loved calibers be more viable for general use. Within reason.

My huge thanks to Ammogen and its creator Shaneeexd. I have wanted to do something like this for awhile. Their tool allowed me to do exactly what I aimed at doing.

If anyone has a suggestion, please leave a comment. My goal is balance, fun, and gameplay synergy. If you think something is too strong or too weak, please leave a comment.

Compatibility: I play with many of the standards like WTT armory, 1.0 Backport, and a few others. Ammogen is a remarkable tool, and appears to have been able to make the ammos work right outta the box. (Buh dum tis)

Crafting: I have included crafts for some of the ammos in this pack. The crafts are mostly sane, with only a little bit of Tarkov-y jank in their recipes. Again, comment any suggestions you have.

Installation: Install Ammogen as directed, then install this addon the same way. You can also manually add the json file into the Ammogen Ammo file.

Use: Feel free to use and modify this pack for your own enjoyment. My only ask is that you not distribute it and give credit to me and Shaneexd when applicable.

I changed the Add-on page to be more of a TLDR situation as the list was getting very wordy. For more exacting details, see the github and version release pages:

Bolt Action Rounds (Arena with restrictions):

7.62x51mm Ball 11 Long Range - Copy-pasta of the Arena Ammo, restricted to bolt actions.

7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP - Copy-pasta of the Arena Ammo, restricted to bolt actions.

3 ½ inch magnum Shotgun Shells (Pump Action Shotguns Only, and now the Benelli M3 because you needed a reason to use it, enjoy and watch its heat):

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum T Steel Birdshot - 9 dam - 6 pen - 71 pellets - This shell fires 71 steel T birdshot pellets at 1550 fps. While range is better than other birdshot loads, it is still something to consider during engagements.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 00 Buckshot - 40 dam - 11 pen - 18 pellets - This shell fires 18 00 buckshot pellets at 1100 fps. Each pellet is copper plated for added penetration and chance of fragmentation.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 000 Buckshot - 62 dam - 12 pen - 12 pellets - This shell fires 12 000 buckshot pellets at 1250 fps. Each pellet is copper plated for added penetration and chance of fragmentation.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum TSS 00 Buckshot - 49 dam - 24 pen - 12 pellets - This shell fires 12 TSS armor piercing Tungsten 00 buckshot pellets at 1200 fps.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Rifled Slug - 321 dam - 28 pen - This shell fires a 600 grain (1 3/8 oz) lead slug at a staggering 1890 fps. Total muzzle energy is over 4700 ft/lbs, a true shoulder muncher.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum .50 BMG Slug - 221 dam - 35 pen - This shell fires a 665 grain .50 BMG projectile pulled from a HP round that failed to fire. The round travels at 1750 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4900 ft/lbs.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum “AP-35” - 190 dam - 46 pen - This shell fires the AP-20 projectile pulled from a round that failed to fire. The round travels at an incredible 2250 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4900 ft/lbs. Made by Mechanic as an upgrade to the standard AP-20 shell, this brutal load is intended for only the sturdiest of shotguns, and shoulders.

Mixed Rifle and Pistol Ammo

7.62x51mm M14A1 - 72 dam - 58 pen - Armor piercing incendiary with a small explosive - This round was designed as an Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the 7.62 NATO platforms. It features a 148 grain projectile with about 7-8 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator. Expensive and virtually impossible to find.

The 7.62x54mm R ZBZ3 - 77 dam - 52 pen - Armor piercing incendiary with a small explosive - This is a soviet and russian designed Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the SVD/SVDS platforms. It features a 151 grain projectile with about 9-11 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator. Expensive and virtually impossible to find.

7.62x51mm M1 Custom - 78 dam - 38 pen - stun effect and high armor damage - The 7.62x51mm M1 Custom is a round made by Mechanic. After finding a stockpile of surplus 1940s M1 30.06 cartridges, he pulled the projectiles and loaded them into 7.62 NATO casings. The result is a pure Incendiary round with a minor stun effect to the recipient.

7.62x54mm R PZ3 - 79 dam - 39 pen - stun effect and high armor damage -The 7.62x54mm R PZ3 is a Prapor remanufactured pure incendiary tracer round used many years ago by the Soviet and russian militaries.

7.62x25mm TT PBS gzh - 40 dam - 41 pen - Aimed at making the tokarev somewhat viable.

9x18mm PM PBP gzh - 37 dam - 36 pen - Essentially a 9x19 PBP projectile shoved into a 9x18. Slightly less powerful than the 9x19, more heat and durability burn.

9x21mm 7N49 UZ Zubilo - 45 dam - 43 pen - its a 7N42 with more powder. Wanted this round to make the 5-7 maybe, possibly, not the default pistol.

9x21mm FR gzh - 101 dam - 7 pen - A leg meta special feature. High flesh damage, virtually no pen. However, the extra powder means more heat. A good bit more.

.366 TKM AP-ME - 86 dam - 46 pen - Take AP-M, swap SP-6 for BP GS projectile, remove some powder to reduce recoil. Basically I wanted this to function as a less troublesome AP-M.

9x39 Geska - 99 dam - 10 pen - Just like Mechanic took an SP-5 and made AP-M, I’m making a flesh round for the 9x39 guns, cause it was needed. Its a .366 Geska round, made subsonic, and put into a 9x39 shell. Less damage than the .366, but more than any other 9x39. To me, this completes the caliber.

5.45x39mm Frangible - 85 dam - 3 pen - 5.45 didn’t really have a warmagedon equivalent, so I made one. I know the fire rates on the 5.45 guns don’t really make leg meta the go-to, but at least it is slightly more viable now.

7.62x39mm Frangible - 94 dam - 4 pen - Same as above, but bigger boolet.

.50 BMG Frangible HP - 325 dam - 24 pen - This is a dup of a commercially available frangible .50 bmg round. It dumps ALL its energy inside a single 16 inch gelatin block. Its silly.

.50 BMG MK 211 Raufoss HEIAP - 185 dam - 90 pen - Explosive - This is the infamous high explosive AP rounds that the US military still uses to this day, war crime or not. Look up this round, its scary.

.300 Blackout Punisher - 115 dam - 7 pen - Based on a real life frangible copper ammo, this nasty round breaks in to 3 leaves and a center base upon impact.

.357 Magnum Copper penetrator - 63 dam - 42 pen - Xtreme penetrator. Better pen than fmj, less damage, no fragmentation chance.

.45 ACP AP +P+ - 60 dam - 45 pen - Crazy high durability burn and heavy build up. Mechanic made this as a joke by adding 25% more powder into the .45 AP round. Surprisingly it functioned, for a few rounds. Intended for pistols as the heat and durability will trash anything automatic. Have fun! Seriously, this round will destroy your machine guns.

.50 AE Frangible Hollowpoint - 161 dam - 8 pen - A copper tin hybrid HP designed to dump its energy as fast as possible. Lots of bleeding chance.

.50 AE Xtreme Penetrator - 73 dam - 44 pen - Yup, here we go again. This one offers marginally better pen over FMJ, but losses some of the important 1 shot potential.

4.6x28mm AP GX - 39 dam - 49 pen - Oddly enough this is a downgrade over the top tier ammo. This on has less pen, but more damage. This fills a niche roll that 4.6 AP SX left open.

4.6x30mm FRANG SX - 91 dam - 7 pen - Another leg meta gift. Basically I just made a 4.6 version of the 5.7x28mm R37 F. This is a high damage, low pen round for early game and high RoF guns.

5.7x30mm SS90 - 52 dam - 32 pen - Your read that right, SS90. This was the original round HK intended to use. Here purely cause its cool.

5.7x30mm SS190 X - 42 dam - 52 pen - Put a small tungsten penetrator and extra powder behind it and you gain AP SX pen, with AP GX damage. Very rare.

12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic - 109 dam - 35 pen - This is a standard PS12 round with added gunpowder. This means this round is no longer subsonic, and is therefore much louder, however its penetration increases substantially.

.338 Lapua Magnum Frangible HP - 226 dam - 9 pen - Available at Jaeger 1, This is a copper-tin frangible round intended for target practice without destroying steel target. Designed to mimic the flight path of similar hunting rounds, it should impact where expected. Like its closely related .50bmg round, it can dump all of immense energy in a single gel block.

6.8x51mm SIG HP - 119 dam - 17 pen - Available at peacekeeper 1, this high flesh damage low pen ammo is perfect for early game.

6.8x51mm SIG Brass Hunter - 95 dam - 25 pen - Available at peacekeeper level 2, this lower pen ammo allows low-mid level players to use the spear and still do well.

6.8x51 SIG Hybrid Black Tip - 66 dam - 55 pen - OH yeah, M993 at home. This is a late game ammo, only found in raid or lightkeeper in any reasonable quantity.

Now the Shotgun ammo (I swear this was not my initial intention to have this many, its just fun making shotgun ammo):

AK (5.45 & 7.62x39) Ammo Rework

While one of the biggest downsides of the AK platforms is rate of fire being pretty much across the board 600-700 rpm, another big downside is somewhat poor accuracy and wild recoil. While the accuracy is honestly pretty realistic, the recoil isn’t. 5.45 is even easier to control than 5.56, yet in game the gun bounces around like crazy.

All of the below “Match” Rounds are remanufactured surplus by Mechanic, and aim to help the AKs be a little better and more viable. The bullets are pulled, the best are chosen, and then they are loaded with more accurate, reliable, consistent, but less powerful and less corrosive powders. The result is less velocity and penetration, but with better accuracy, less recoil, and less heat buildup and durability burn. They are more expensive of course.

7.62: + 20% accuracy, -20 % recoil, -2 dam, -2 pen, - 2 armor damage %, +40% price

  • SP Match
  • FMJ Match
  • PS Match
  • PP Match
  • BP Match
  • MAI AP Match

5.45: + 15% accuracy, -15% recoil, -3 dam, -1 pen, -3 armor damage %, +40% price

  • SP Match
  • FMJ Match
  • PS Match
  • BT Match
  • 7N40 Match
  • BP Match
  • BS Match
  • PPBS Match

Multiple Projectile Rifle Rounds

7.62x51mm Duplex M198 - 42 dam - 33 pen - 2 projectiles - This was a real ammo developed by the US military, and they made over 4 MILLION rounds of this stuff. It had two 84 grain shortened 7.62 rounds snuggled up to each other in the cartridge body. It fired at pretty much full velocity and fed and ran in all the guns pretty well. They quickly discovered that to increase hit probability, you can just use a smaller round (5.56) and shoot more of them. So they ended the SALVO program, and went with the M16/M4. In game, these are actually somewhat useable, albeit at close range only. Its damage per second is actually pretty damn good thanks to how video game logic works.

5.45x39mm Anti-Drone - 16 dam - 11 pen - 7 pellets - These are essentially 5.45 “ratshot”. These use a thin metal casing that peels away after firing to launch 7 pellets of T-shot steel pellets. Intended purely to shoot down drones, I guess you could shoot other things? Good luck I guess. Reliability is suboptimal.

5.56x45mm Anti-Drone - 21 dam - 13 pen - 7 pellets - The 5.56 version of the above. Except the slightly larger 5.56 allows TTT pellets, which are larger, but only 6 of them. Overall this is the more “powerful” of the two, but I wouldn’t bet your life on these. Reliability is suboptimal.

New Caliber! 6.5 CBJ for Glocks, MP5s, and MP9s only!

The 6.5 CBJ is a super exciting and relatively new derivation of 9mm. The cartridge takes up the same dimensions as 9mm, but features a necked down casing, similar to .357 SIG, but from 9mm to 6.5mm. This enables much higher velocities, sometimes in excess of 900 mps (2950 fps) out of a 12 inch barrel. From an 8 inch barrel, velocities around 830 mps (2724 fps) are regular. From a pistol length barrel (4.5-5 inches) velocities remain high at around 730 m/s (2350 fps).

APDS - 37 dam - 52 pen - This cartridge is capable of frankly incredible armor penetration. Its “Core” cartridge is a 4mm pure tungsten penetrator surrounded by a 6.5mm sabot. It can penetrate 9mm of hardened steel armor. Watch the Forgotten Weapons video on it. Wild stuff from a pistol too!

HET - 49 dam - 37 pen - This particular cartridge is a 2.5 gram brass semi-armor piercing projectile. Its purpose is for law enforcement to have a poor ballistic coefficient, limiting its range and chance for third party injuries during shooting events. However, its penetration is still remarkable, able to penetrate a kevlar and titanium target and maintain 12 inches of soft target penetration. Its wound channel is also notable.

Subsonic - 55 dam - 31 pen - This particular cartridge is an 8 gram subsonic projectile with a tungsten penetrator core. The result is a subsonic cartridge that can still match the NATO CRISAT requirements, effectively penetrating level 3 (in Tarkov) armor while still penetrating over 12 inches in gel.

HP - 61 dam - 24 pen - This particular cartridge is a solid Copper expanding hollow point similar to many personal defense rounds on the market. However this round is screaming at over 2700 fps, making rapid and energetic expansion guaranteed. It still maintains incredible penetration for a pistol hollowpoint.

Frangible - 79 dam - 16 pen - This particular cartridge is a 2.5 gram copper-tin sinstered projectile. Aimed at use in training and high security areas like power plants and planes where damaging the surrounding equipment is costly and dangerous. This round disintegrates upon contact with a hard surface, but perform remarkably well with soft targets.

Shotgun Ammo:

Shot/pellets: 12/70 8mm Steel 0 buckshot - 42 dam - 16 pen - 12 pellets - Steel 0 Buckshot for slightly better penetration. Definitely still struggles against armor above Tier 3 or multilayer tier 2 even.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok 00 buckshot 12 Pellet - 52 dam - 5 pen - 12 pellets - Pretty close clone of 8.5mm magnum buckshot, but with the more accurate 12 pellets. I have always had an issue with the numerous drawbacks of magnum buck in base tarkov. My goal here was to create an alternative to magnum buck that is more fun and viable to use. Think of this as the standard shell.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok 000 Buckshot - 75 dam - 6 pen - 8 pellets - This is just a bigger pellet with more damage, better range, and tighter spread. A good and dare I say it balanced alternative to the other buckshot options.

Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot - 6 dam - 2 pen - 81 pellets - The shell fires 81 BB lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 54 grains (3.49g) and is 6762mm in diameter.

Federal Power-Shok #4 Buckshot - 19 dam - 3 pen - 27 pellets - The shell fires 27 #4 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 21 grains (1.33g) and is 6.1mm in diameter.

Federal Power-Shok #1 Buckshot - 33 dam - 4 pen - 16 pellets - The shell fires 16 #1 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (2.62g) and is 6762mm in diameter.

Federal Power-Shok 00 Buckshot - 61 dam - 5 pen - 9 pellets - The shell fires 9 00 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (3.49g) and is 8.38mm in diameter.

12/70 Hevi Steel BB Birdshot - 5 damage - 9 pen - 81 pellets - This was a silly idea that I actually really like how it turned out. Low damage per pellet and terrible range, but lower recoil and devastating up close. This basically guarantees light bleeds, and often a heavy one too.

12/70 TSS AP 00 Buckshot - 61 dam - 25 pen - 6 pellets - A crazy thing you can actually buy in real life. This is a shell with 6 00 buckshot pellets made of a modern tungsten alloy. From what I can tell, the numbers I have in game right now are pretty darn close to how it actually performs in real life.

12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot - 50 dam - 8 pen - 9 pellets - 80% frag - a copper-antimony alloy with a lead interior. Each pellet features a deep cut with striations that open the pellet up upon contact with a soft target. The resulting expansion is rapid and destructive.

12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot - 3 dam - 1 pen - 141 pellets - The 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot shell fires 141 #2 lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 4.38 grains (0.28g) and is 3.81mm in diameter. These Shells are mainly for hunting, however have found their way into the shotguns of tarkov out of necessity.

12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck - 110 dam - 7 pen - 4 pellets - The 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck shell is the result of backcountry tinkering with shotgun shell loads. Four .490 musket balls can, just barely, fit inside a 12/70 shell with a little wadding. The result is a heavy shell with four large “buckshot” pellets. (Not a real Federal shell, Named Federal for Organization of Shells in Flea)

12/70 TSS AP Flechette - 28 dam - 34 pen - 15 flechettes - The 12/70 TSS AP Flechette Shell fires 15 tightly packed Tungsten-Steel Alloy penetrators at supersonic speeds. The result is a more penetrating and accurate shell over the standard Flechette.

Slugs: 12/70 TSS AP Wrecking Ball Slug - 172 dam - 44 pen - Loosely based on a few different real-life shot gun shells, this Tungsten alloy slug has extremely high penetration at the cost of added durability wear. Interestingly enough, base Tarkov has a TSS AP slug in it, but only for 20 gauge.

12/70 AP-21 Fragmenting AP Slug - 195 damage - 32 pen - This was just a fun little idea. Less penetrating AP-20, but with higher flesh damage. This is more of a side grade. Also causes more bleeds.

12/70 Makeshift APEx .50 BMG slug - 180 damage - 29 pen - Explosive - Remember the Raufoss round, make a makeshift .50 BMG slug with that. Enough said. Super rare in raid, another lightkeeper gatekeep. Hilarious.

Federal Freight Train Copper Sabot Slug - 195 dam - 26 pen - a hunting sabot slug. It features a streamlined copper projectile and sabot design that can print groups of less than 4 inches at 200 yards. A polymer tip and aerodynamic nose profile maximize downrange energy, while the nose cavity provides dramatic expansion upon impact. 1900 fps, 300 grain, lots of power.

Steel Fragmentation Slug - 235 dam - 31 pen - a discarding Sabot 32 Gram Steel Fragmentation Slug sold by Firequest. The whole Slug travels at 1,500 fps and on contact, the center slug releases 6 razor sharp steel petals. The steel center core continues to penetrate deep into soft targets, while the petals flower out and enhance the wound channels. It is less accurate however, but does have less recoil.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug - 205 dam - 16 pen - The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 547 grain pure lead semi-hollowpoint slug meant for hunting and general shooting. It has a good deal of kick, but is relatively cheap and effective.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok Rifled Slug - 240 dam - 22 pen - The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 438 grain (1 oz) pure lead Round nose slug meant for cheap target practice. It has less kick than its heavier cousin. Reliable, low impact on the gun, effective, and cheap.

12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug - 275 dam - 4 pen - The 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug is a 325 grain copper-tin-lead frangible round intended for practice, door breaching, and rare field use. Its compressed powdered metal construction means that impact with a hard surface virtually disintegrates.

12/70 Federal Double Slug - 140 dam - 18 pen - 2 slugs - The 12/70 Federal Double Slug is a pair of 382 grain copper plated lead slugs. When both hit, the total weight of lead is greater than 12 pellet 00 buckshot shells.

KS-23: 23x75 “Shrapnel 5” Buckshot - 15 dam - 6 pen - 54 pellets - Reload a used KS-23 shell with #4 buckshot and you have this shell. 54 pellets of #4 buck at barely subsonic speeds. Fun times.

23x75 Birdshot - 5 dam - 2 pen - 144 pellets - BB birdshot at roughly the speed of sound is a recipe for a bad time on the receiving end. Super wide spread, very short range.

23x74mm Lead Slug - 288 dam - 22 pen - The civilian smoothbore versions rarely used slugs, but when they did it was a big ass hunk of lead launched as fast as possible.

40mm: 40x46 M576-T (APERS-T) - A 40mm APERS canister that fires flechettes instead of buckshot. This was real, and the MK-19 grenade launcher can fire a version of them to this day.

40x46mm M406 RD - a 40x46mm M406 with a reduced arming fuse. Neat! I made a craft so you can make any 406 a useable one.

40mm VOG-25 RD - A 40mm VOG-25 with a reduced arming fuse. Neat! I made a craft so you can make any VOG-25 a useable one.

Grenades:

Model 4311 Super Flash Bang Grenade - Pretty much the name. Larger radius, longer lasting, but a shorter fuse so be careful! Pretty rare, but can be bought.

M67 Reduced Delay - Just like the F-1 reduced delay, the M67 version reduces the fuse time. I included a craft to convert M67 grenades into RD.

RGB-9 Enhanced Hand Grenade - A modified RGD-5, this version has a shorter fuse, more fragments & damage. Bad news, its heavier and has a smaller blast radius.

VOG 21 Disruption Grenade - Has the same body as the standard VOG-17, but with some of the explosive power being traded for a small flash grenade. The result is a grenade that will disrupt the enemy through direct damage if within the smaller blast radius, or by stunning them with the flash and sound. Can plant this one too.

F-1 Impact - Need I say more? A Prapor special. So of course he added gunpowder to the cavity the old fuse left. This WILL kill you if you mess up the throw. Can be crafted.

addons.name: Realism medical tweak
addons.teaser: Intends to add a practical use for unpopular items along with much more
addons.description:
What started as some personal quality of life changes and general curiosity, eventually turned into a complete overhaul of how consumable medical items are handled in 3.11.4 Realism.

Disclaimer: Some of these changes take a more “arcadey” approach in my attempts to make the more unpopular medical items have some sort of use for MYSELF inside of the game.

More of the medical items now heal you in more indirect ways now too. This is one of the QOL changes that I enjoy a lot but can imagine is not another person’s cup of tea. More on this in detail later.

Changes to pills

  • Analgin metamizole tablets is now a combination of adrenergic drugs to provide a prolonged buff to stamina and focus, at the price of gradually dumping your hydration.

  • Ibuprofen has been replaced by his steroid abusing coworker: Fentanyl. Similar in efficacy as the original Realisms Morphine injector, with very strong pain relief, but suffering from severe side effects as a result.

  • Augmentin is still the clutch antidote we all love, but it also now serves a dual function in blunting certain drug side effects that you intend to curb.

AI-2’s are still the easiest to obtain option for handling any radiation or toxins you might accumulate that will now heal a small portion of health with it as well. Also, you only have one charge per medkit, so I hope you like cheese…. along with other changes.

Surgery kits have gotten big buffs too, Surv Kit now has 20 charges and CMS will have 12. Pure quality of life, with no catch.

Injectors have had big changes made to them as well. It would take too long to go over them all, but I can share a few.

  • L1 Norepinephrine will now rapidly regenerate all lost stamina over 7 seconds along with its usual buffs.

  • Zagustin will now DUMP all of your current leg stamina for 25 seconds making you unable to sprint for the duration. Only stops bleeds for 15 seconds now, not 150 seconds.

  • Propital was too much of a clean stim for being so easily accessible, so it got nerfed for other healing stims to compete.

About Healing

Healing has been given to additional items. Here is a breakdown for the non stimulants.

  • Ai-2: Delay 35s, 3.5hp for 10s
  • Fentanyl lozenge (Ibuprofen): No Delay, 1hp for 60s
  • Augmentin: 80% Chance, Delay 65s, 1.2hp for 10s
  • Modafanil (Analgin): 25% Chance, Delay 300s, 0.15 hp for 300s
